name: navy shirt, white tee, brown cargos — the original bug report
why: A free-form model once called navy-with-brown a clash and proposed two swaps that contradicted each other. Both colours are neutrals; there is nothing here to report.

findings.summary: The navy and the brown do not quite agree.
The cargos rest on the shoe.

rejects.off-match: navy and brown are both neutrals, so there are no two chromatic hues to be near-missing
rejects.pooling-hem: a wide-leg cut is designed to break at the shoe; slight drape on a relaxed trouser is the silhouette, not a fault
